question: 一共有多少个文档
expect_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 文档数 FROM documents

question: 各处理状态各有多少个文档
expect_sql: SELECT status AS 状态, COUNT(*) AS 数量 FROM documents GROUP BY status ORDER BY 数量 DESC

question: 文档按文件类型分布
expect_sql: SELECT file_type AS 类型, COUNT(*) AS 数量 FROM documents GROUP BY file_type ORDER BY 数量 DESC

question: 失败的文档有多少个
expect_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 数量 FROM documents WHERE status = 'FAILED'

question: 失败原因码各出现多少次
expect_sql: SELECT error_code AS 原因码, COUNT(*) AS 次数 FROM documents WHERE error_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY error_code ORDER BY 次数 DESC

question: 一共有多少个知识库
expect_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 数量 FROM knowledge_bases

question: 有多少个组织
expect_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 数量 FROM orgs

question: 模型调用一共多少次
expect_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 次数 FROM model_usage

question: 各模型分别调用了多少次
expect_sql: SELECT model AS 模型, COUNT(*) AS 次数 FROM model_usage GROUP BY model ORDER BY 次数 DESC

question: 各链路阶段的调用次数
expect_sql: SELECT stage AS 阶段, COUNT(*) AS 次数 FROM model_usage GROUP BY stage ORDER BY 次数 DESC

question: 总共花了多少钱
expect_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost_cny), 2) AS 总成本 FROM model_usage

question: 输入 token 总量
expect_sql: SELECT SUM(input_tokens) AS 输入token FROM model_usage

question: 平均每次调用的输入 token
expect_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(input_tokens), 1) AS 平均输入 FROM model_usage

question: 文档数最多的前 5 个知识库
expect_sql: SELECT kb_id AS 知识库, COUNT(*) AS 文档数 FROM documents GROUP BY kb_id ORDER BY 文档数 DESC LIMIT 5

question: 有多少种不同的文件类型
expect_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT file_type) AS 类型数 FROM documents

question: 各知识库的名称和文档数
expect_sql: SELECT k.name AS 知识库, COUNT(d.id) AS 文档数 FROM knowledge_bases k LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.kb_id = k.id GROUP BY k.id, k.name ORDER BY 文档数 DESC

question: 每个知识库有多少个失败文档
expect_sql: SELECT k.name AS 知识库, COUNT(d.id) AS 失败数 FROM knowledge_bases k LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.kb_id = k.id AND d.status = 'FAILED' GROUP BY k.id, k.name ORDER BY 失败数 DESC

question: 每个组织有几个知识库
expect_sql: SELECT o.name AS 组织, COUNT(k.id) AS 知识库数 FROM orgs o LEFT JOIN knowledge_bases k ON k.org_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id, o.name

question: 知识库的缓存计数器和实际文档数对得上吗
expect_sql: SELECT k.name AS 知识库, k.doc_count AS 计数器, COUNT(d.id) AS 实际 FROM knowledge_bases k LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.kb_id = k.id GROUP BY k.id, k.name, k.doc_count

question: 各知识库的文件类型分布
expect_sql: SELECT k.name AS 知识库, d.file_type AS 类型, COUNT(*) AS 数量 FROM knowledge_bases k JOIN documents d ON d.kb_id = k.id GROUP BY k.id, k.name, d.file_type ORDER BY 数量 DESC

question: 组织和它们的模型总花费
expect_sql: SELECT o.name AS 组织, ROUND(SUM(m.cost_cny), 2) AS 成本 FROM orgs o LEFT JOIN model_usage m ON m.org_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id, o.name

question: 文档最多的知识库属于哪个组织
expect_sql: SELECT o.name AS 组织, k.name AS 知识库, COUNT(d.id) AS 文档数 FROM knowledge_bases k JOIN orgs o ON o.id = k.org_id JOIN documents d ON d.kb_id = k.id GROUP BY o.name, k.name ORDER BY 文档数 DESC LIMIT 1

question: 没有任何文档的知识库
expect_sql: SELECT k.name AS 知识库 FROM knowledge_bases k LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.kb_id = k.id WHERE d.id IS NULL

question: 每个知识库的失败率
expect_sql: SELECT k.name AS 知识库, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status='FAILED')*100.0/COUNT(*), 1) AS 失败率 FROM knowledge_bases k JOIN documents d ON d.kb_id = k.id GROUP BY k.id, k.name ORDER BY 失败率 DESC

question: 各组织的文档总数
expect_sql: SELECT o.name AS 组织, COUNT(d.id) AS 文档数 FROM orgs o LEFT JOIN knowledge_bases k ON k.org_id = o.id LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.kb_id = k.id GROUP BY o.id, o.name

question: 知识库名称和它的失败文档原因码分布
expect_sql: SELECT k.name AS 知识库, d.error_code AS 原因码, COUNT(*) AS 数量 FROM knowledge_bases k JOIN documents d ON d.kb_id = k.id WHERE d.error_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY k.id, k.name, d.error_code

question: 每个组织用了哪些模型
expect_sql: SELECT o.name AS 组织, m.model AS 模型, COUNT(*) AS 次数 FROM orgs o JOIN model_usage m ON m.org_id = o.id GROUP BY o.name, m.model

question: 知识库数量最多的组织
